summary: Track 25 Sprint 3 · /admin/storage-recovery domain landing tested end-to-end via Playwright as super-admin (jaymn.judd@mascigc.com). All acceptance criteria verified: root testid, executive verdict panel (pill/summary/highest/counts/last-refreshed/sources), 4 sections, 7 health cards with all required sub-testids, evidence drawer open/Escape close, search + 5 status filters, 5 maintenance action deep-links, 9 trust gap rows, recent events list, refresh button, back-to-AdminOS button. Regressions clean: AdminOS renders 10 domain cards with storage-recovery routing to /admin/storage-recovery; OCC Trust Layer intact with trust-card-recovery_snapshot present and its drawer drilldown now points to /admin/storage-recovery; legacy /admin/recovery still loads; OCC ?highlight=storage.safe_cleanup highlights the correct occ-card-storage.safe_cleanup. Zero-UTC audit passed — no raw ISO / GMT / Z-suffix strings on the page (all times rendered as 'Just now' / 'X min ago' / 'Jul 10, 2026 · 12:04 AM'). Tablet 768x1024 viewport stacks cleanly. Backend probes all returned 200 (recovery/snapshot, backups-scheduler-state, integrations/health).
action_items: MINOR (naming polish, not a blocker): Trust gap row test IDs are double-prefixed as `storage-recovery-gap-gap-r2-orphan-cleanup` because the code emits `storage-recovery-gap-${g.id}` where g.id already begins with 'gap-'. All 9 rows render correctly with correct data — this is only a testid naming smell. If the review contract expects `storage-recovery-gap-r2-orphan-cleanup` (single 'gap-' prefix), strip the prefix from g.id or change the template to `storage-recovery-${g.id}`.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminStorageRecovery.jsx is 889 lines — approaching the 700-line soft limit. Consider extracting card-builder functions (bDiskPreflight, bR2Bucket, ...), MAINTENANCE_ACTIONS, TRUST_GAPS, and SECTIONS into sibling modules under /pages/admin/storage_recovery/ for maintainability.

Line 132: template literal `Plan retention run before hitting the ${alert} GB alert.` is inside a regular JS string (single/double quotes), so `${alert}` renders literally instead of interpolating. Change the outer quotes to backticks. (Cosmetic — the YELLOW banner will read '${alert} GB alert' verbatim to the operator.)
Overall visual language, PortalShell/SideNavV3 chrome, TrustStatusPill palette and card stripe pattern are consistent with AdminOS + OCC Sprint 2 output. Good reuse of TrustPrimitives.
